text.text_excerpt: Great restaurant, we finally tried it for New Years Eve and weren't disappointed. Our rabbit terrine and crawfish ginger dumpling appetizers were great, and my fiancee loved her bouillbaisse entre plus her dessert. My bacon-wrapped filet was just average (and underseasoned) and I clearly seem to have chosen wrong by getting the steak instead of duck confit. For dessert my pear tart tatin was also fine but not outstanding and I usually prefer apple for that preparation so I probably could have chosen better there as well. Overall the service was good, the atmosphere was nice, and most of the food was outstanding. This is certainly a haunt for locals who live in the French Quarter and now I...

Meauxbar is a lovely restaurant on the "back side" (on Rampart) of the French Quarter. The food was inspired by local cuisine, but not as heavy. The frites (fries) are a must. The service was great, although it was a shame that the waiter was not confident and could not offer suggestions outside of "what he eats" which seems to be quite limited. It wasn't very crowded, but I understand that when it is, it's kinda loud. Great wine selection. Meauxbar was light, lively, easy, and lacking in any pretense. Highly recommended.

Yay! There is a culinary god and he has brought redemption to Meauxbar. A year ago, I had an evening there that was like a descent in Dante's 7th level of (customer service) hell. I swore never to return. Last night, I was cornered into returning by two absolutely fabulous upriver ladies. I did so with more than a little trepidation. Until I sat down. The service could not have been better. What had been a generally grumpy attitude among the staff had morphed into a typical New Orleans vibe. And the food?
